record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.original_question: Do there exist infinitesimal symmetries Q(P) of finite-dimensional affine Poisson manifolds that are simultaneously nonlinear, proper, and nontrivial in Poisson cohomology, meaning they are not of the form [[P,X]] up to terms proportional to [[P,P]]? If no such examples exist, what mechanism forces all currently known universal Poisson cocycles, including those produced from nontrivial graph cocycles by O→r, to become ∂_P-trivial?

evidence.quote: Problem 13. Do there exist nonlinear, proper, and still ∂_P-nontrivial infinitesimal symmetries Q(P) ∈ sym([[P,P]] = 0) of Poisson bi-vectors P on finite-dimensional affine Poisson manifolds M^r_aff ? If the converse it true, what is then the mechanism of ∂_P-triviality of all these Poisson cocycles (in particular, produced by the graph orientation morphism O→r from nontrivial graph cocycles γ ∈ ker d) ?

artifact.category_tag: Kontsevich graph complex and Poisson cohomology
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works on Kontsevich graph flows (e.g., on Nambu-determinant Poisson brackets, 2021–2025) explicitly state that there is no known mechanism explaining why graph-cocycle-induced flows become trivial in Poisson cohomology for generic Poisson structures, and no nonlinear, proper, ∂_P-nontrivial example has been exhibited. The question therefore appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The hidden symmetry of Kontsevich's graph flows on the spaces of Nambu-determinant Poisson brackets
status_evidence.snippet: There is no known mechanism for Kontsevich's graph flows to be trivial in the second Poisson cohomology of P for nontrivial graph cocycles γ and generic Poisson structures.
status_evidence.claim: As of the cited work, the triviality mechanism remains unidentified, and no nontrivial example is known.

status_evidence.title: Kontsevich's graph flows of Nambu-determinant Poisson brackets (2025 thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of graph cocycle flows on specific classes of Poisson structures continue, with triviality verified case by case.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work continues to investigate triviality case by case without resolving the general mechanism.
